b: Where: Central skeleton — pelvis, ribs, proximal femur, proximal humerus. Unlike osteosarcoma which loves the knee

snip.t: Therefore, this term includes fibrosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, and osteosarcoma, all named for their morphologic characteristics.

Malignant tumours use epithelial origin → carcinoma (squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma); mesenchymal origin → sarcoma (liposarcoma, fibrosarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, osteosarcoma, chondrosarcoma, angiosarcoma).
Risk: Cartilage cap >2 cm in adults → suspect malignant transformation to chondrosarcoma
